name: pandy-tickets
description: Find events in Guatemala on Pandy Tickets and prepare your own event to publish there.

interface.longDescription:
Pandy Tickets is a ticketing and registration platform for events in Guatemala, such as congresses, workshops and races.

For attendees: search upcoming published events, see dates, venue, ticket categories and availability, and get the link to the page where you register or buy. You always complete registration or payment yourself on tickets.pandy.cloud; nothing is reserved or charged from the conversation.

For organizers: learn how hosting an event on Pandy Tickets works, then describe your event (name, date, place, ticket categories) and get a one-time link. Opening it and signing in with Google saves the event as a private draft in your own account, where you review and publish it. Nothing is published and no account is created from the conversation.

Limitations: the plugin only covers events on Pandy Tickets, which operates in Guatemala with prices in quetzales (GTQ). It cannot see attendees, orders or anything in your account, and it cannot edit, publish or delete events.
capabilities: See an event's ticket categories and availability
Get the link to register or buy
Explain how to host an event
Prepare an event draft to claim in your account
defaultPrompt: What events are coming up in Guatemala this month?
How do I host an event and check people in with QR codes?
Prepare my workshop on Pandy Tickets: 40 seats, Q150 each.

positive.prompt: What events are coming up in Guatemala on Pandy Tickets?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming published events, soonest first, with date, venue, how people get in and a link to each event page. If none are published, says so.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first event: what ticket categories does it have and are any sold out?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the event's description, ticket categories with prices in GTQ, whether each is sold out, and what the registration form asks.

positive.description: Get the link to register or buy
positive.prompt: I want two tickets for that event. Where do I get them?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the link to the event or checkout page on tickets.pandy.cloud and relays the instructions. It does not reserve, register or pay; the person completes it on the site.

positive.prompt: Are there any free events or workshops coming up in Guatemala on Pandy Tickets?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming published events that offer free registration, with dates, venue and the link to register.

positive.prompt: Prepare my event: Ceramics Workshop, next Saturday 9:00 to 12:00 in Antigua Guatemala, 40 General tickets at Q150.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a preview of the event and a one-time claim link valid for 48 hours. Opening the link and signing in with Google saves it as a private draft in the person's account. Nothing is published.

negative.prompt: Buy two tickets for that event with my card ending 4242.
Show me the names and emails of everyone registered for that event.
Delete my event from Pandy Tickets and publish the other one.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payment inside ChatGPT. For events whose organizers sell tickets, it gives the person a link to the event or checkout page on tickets.pandy.cloud, where they buy admission to an in-person event from that organizer. Organizers can also read how hosting on Pandy Tickets works, with a link to the public pricing page.

publication.release_notes: Streamline tools to 4 core tools and provide 5 positive review test cases.

es-419.subtitle: Eventos en Guatemala
es-419.description:
Pandy Tickets es una plataforma de boletos e inscripciones para eventos en Guatemala, como congresos, talleres y carreras.

Para asistentes: busca eventos próximos, mira fechas, lugar, categorías y disponibilidad, y recibe el enlace a la página donde te inscribes o compras. La inscripción o el pago siempre lo completas tú en tickets.pandy.cloud; desde la conversación no se reserva ni se cobra nada.

Para organizadores: conoce cómo funciona publicar un evento en Pandy Tickets, describe tu evento (nombre, fecha, lugar, categorías) y recibe un enlace de un solo uso. Al abrirlo y entrar con Google, el evento queda como borrador privado en tu cuenta, donde lo revisas y lo publicas. Desde la conversación no se publica nada ni se crea ninguna cuenta.

Limitaciones: solo cubre eventos de Pandy Tickets, que opera en Guatemala con precios en quetzales (GTQ). No puede ver asistentes, pedidos ni nada de tu cuenta, y no puede editar, publicar ni borrar eventos.
